top_signals.title: Gold Extends Drop as Hot US Inflation Reinforces Fed Hike Bets
top_signals.summary: Gold extended its decline after a key gauge of US inflation came in hotter than expected, reinforcing bets that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates next month.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: US Stocks Futures Drop After Hot Inflation Boosts Rate Hike Bets
top_signals.summary: US equity futures dropped after hotter-than-expected inflation data released on Tuesday bolstered the case for an interest rate hike by the Federal Reserve in December.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Fed Shouldn’t Do a 50 Bps Rate Hike, JPM’s Kelly Says
top_signals.summary: David Kelly, chief global strategist at JPMorgan Asset Management, explains why a half-point rate hike by the Federal Reserve is not needed next month, following a higher-than-expected rise in the US consumer price index. He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Ship Carrying Russian Diesel Makes U-Turn After Heading to US
top_signals.summary: A tanker carrying Russian diesel that had briefly signaled the US made a U-turn about 400 nautical miles off New York, compounding uncertainty over deliveries to the North American market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
